purpose: source-grounded interpretation of one HTML table by a separate Claude agent in a fresh context, in a form that can be compared cell by cell and element by element with the PEE table decision ledger (src/table_ledger1e.ts); it is separation from PEE's output, not independent human ground truth
cellIdentity: source coordinates: r = index of the <tr> among the table's own rows in document order (0-based), c = index of the <td>/<th> within that <tr> (0-based); the same identity the ledger records as sourceRow/sourceCell

TableAnnotation.structure: one of: single_subject_properties | products_in_columns | products_in_rows | measure_by_condition_matrix | specification_sheet | ratings_or_scores | layout_not_data | mixed | other

rowAxis.role: product | property | measure | condition | appliance_or_method | rating_criterion | none | other
rowAxis.evidence: short paraphrase of the source evidence

TableAnnotation.headerCells: array of {r,c}: cells that act as labels (whatever their tag)
TableAnnotation.evidenceType: one of: publisher_measured | manufacturer_declared | certified_rating | calculated_or_estimated | editorial_rating | mixed | unclear (for the table as a whole)
TableAnnotation.evidenceSupport: array of {where: table_heading | caption | section_text | page_text | header_cell | none, paraphrase}: where the evidence type is established; none if the source does not establish it
TableAnnotation.cells: array of CellAnnotation, one per source cell (every cell, including labels and empty cells)
TableAnnotation.alternatives: array of short strings: interpretations considered and rejected, with the reason
TableAnnotation.unresolved: array of short strings: relations the source does not establish

CellAnnotation.role: one of: product_label | property_label | condition_label | measure_label | value | empty | dash | not_applicable | layout | other
CellAnnotation.elements: array of ElementAnnotation (values only; [] for labels, empty, dash, layout)

ElementAnnotation.surface: the exact substring of the cell text holding the number (and its unit or currency) as printed
ElementAnnotation.unit: unit as printed, or null if none is printed in the cell; unitFrom: cell | column_header | row_header | caption | none
ElementAnnotation.kind: one of: measured | declared | nominal_certified | setting | derived_or_estimated | price | rating_score | identifier | other
ElementAnnotation.product: exact product name the source establishes for this element, or null
ElementAnnotation.variant: variant designation if the source states one, else null
ElementAnnotation.dimension: short label (noise, power, energy, time, brightness, airflow, capacity, size, weight, cost, ...)
ElementAnnotation.conditions: array of short labels the source states for this element (fan speed, mode, programme, window size...), [] if none
ElementAnnotation.dashMeaning: for a dash or empty cell only: not_applicable | not_measured | unknown, with the source evidence; unknown when the source says nothing
ElementAnnotation.uncertain: true when the source does not let you decide kind, product or unit

rules: measured only when the source states (in the table, its heading or caption, its section or elsewhere on the page) that the publisher itself measured or tested this quantity; otherwise declared, nominal_certified, derived_or_estimated or unclear
a statement of measurement elsewhere on the page counts only if it plausibly covers this table (same quantity, same section or an explicit reference); record where
names differing by model code, size, region or suffix are different products unless the page equates them
a dash or empty cell is never zero; its meaning is unknown unless the source explains it
do not use any PEE output: none is provided
